name: HED Jet 9 RC Black track wheelset
spec_notes: rear is single-side fixed (standard 1.37"x24tpi cog threading)
description:
HED Jet Series Track wheels are stiff, very aero, and proudly made with precision and proven speed technology in the USA.
Supplied by HED at our request, these wheels are built using Jet RC Black rims, featuring their patented Turbine Braking Technology - a uniquely textured, all black sidewall that doesn't look like a machined brake surface.
This detailed design, in addition to providing the option to use brakes on otherwise brakeless track wheels, greatly increases brake power in both wet and dry conditions, yet retains the look of non-machined sidewalls for brakeless purists.
Utilizing a super lightweight carbon fairing manufactured in HED's Minnesota facility fused to a 25mm wide aluminum rim, laced 2X using Sapim CX-Ray bladed spokes to 7075 aluminum HED Sonic high flange hubs w/ stainless steel 6001 sealed cartridge bearings, the Jet Track Series checks all the boxes when sprinting or partaking in longer endurance events.
